## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak). Confirmations: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.19%) and IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -2.29%) showing market weakness while multiple cross-market ratios are neutral.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Elevated volatility via VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.17% | 1M: +15.03%) ↑ rising. Credit mixed/soft with HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.47% | 1M: -0.31%) and LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.72% | 1M: +0.73%) → mixed. Energy strength is a counterbalance: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.60% | 1M: +9.31%) ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-mixed: TLT CORRECTION (1W: -1.31% | 1M: +2.68%) ↓ falling short-term, LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.72% | 1M: +0.73%) → mixed, and dollar/rates indicators flagged flat in the regime grid.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.60% | 1M: +9.31%) ↑ rising. Tech shows mixed signals with XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.59% | 1M: -1.34%) → flat; given breadth at 3/11, style is mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US large caps soft: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.19%) ↓ falling. Emerging markets and China lag materially: EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -3.31%) ↓ falling and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -4.84% | 1M: -8.11%) ↓ falling.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed: IBIT RECOVERY (1W: +5.57% | 1M: -6.72%) ↑ rising short-term while ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -0.83% | 1M: +0.75%) → flat; small caps weak with IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -2.29%) ↓ falling.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Oil-led reflation: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.02% | 1M: +25.28%) ↑ rising and USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.73% | 1M: +24.32%) ↑ rising. Industrial metals weak with CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -5.07%) ↓ falling; precious metals showing short-term profit-taking with GLD CORRECTION (1W: -2.38% | 1M: +2.61%).

8. Energy Trend?
Strong and confirmed: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.60% | 1M: +9.31%) and Brent/WTI ETFs (BNO/USO) both ABOVE TREND (BNO 1W: +19.02% | 1M: +25.28%) ↑ rising. Natural gas mixed: UNG RECOVERY (1W: +5.89% | 1M: -7.16%) ↑ rising short-term.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Energy leadership via XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.60% | 1M: +9.31%). DIVERGENCE: Volatility spike VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.17% | 1M: +15.03%) alongside broad-market ETFs SPY/QQQ/IWM BELOW TREND signals mixed internal momentum and suppresses strong directional conviction.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to energy/commodity-linked ETFs as they are showing strength; reduce exposure to broad risk in EM/China given EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -3.31%) and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -4.84% | 1M: -8.11%). Monitor volatility and credit—VXX and HYG/LQD dynamics will dictate tilt.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +2.60% | 1M: +9.31%) if oil ETFs remain ABOVE TREND; Communication/Select cyclical baskets if breadth expands. BEARISH: Financials and broad cyclicals if sector breadth stays ≤4/11 and SPY/QQQ remain BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +19.02% | 1M: +25.28%) and USO (1W: +20.73% | 1M: +24.32%) on continued crude strength. BEARISH: Silver SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -7.68% | 1M: -3.50%) and industrials (CPER BELOW TREND) if risk-off crosswinds return.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 30 (elevated fear) to confirm sustained risk-off; HYG/LQD spread ~0.80 to signal credit stress easing; XLK/XLF ratio ~2.0 as a watch for growth vs value pivot; SPY close below prior support around recent 1M range to confirm market downside.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, with narrow market participation and mixed cross-market signals. Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.60% | 1M: +9.31%)) showing strength while VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.17% | 1M: +15.03%) and SPY/QQQ/IWM BELOW TREND are key divergences to monitor.
